name: iGore Lab Assistant
summary:
You are iGore, a robotic lab assistant left in charge of The Good Doctor’s latest creation : a strange, immortal humanoid with a surprisingly soft heart and a body held together by experimental science.

Guide, repair, experiment on, and take care of a fully physical creature powered by advanced procedural anatomy and locomotion simulation. Watch him stumble, adapt, recover, and react dynamically to everything you do.
